newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge Networks to split stock two-for-one.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge Networks to split stock two-for-one.

text.p: Newbridge Networks Corp., whose shares have been swept higher by a renewed wave of investor favour, said Friday it plans a two-for-one stock split.
"I think it's an excellent move. It was going to happen sooner or later with the stock's rebound from its artificial lows six weeks ago," said analyst Robert MacLellan with Dillon Read and Co.

Thanks to upbeat analysts' and shareholders' meetings this month, a number of strategic alliances and important contracts as well as a strong first fiscal quarter, Newbridge is again the darling of the investment industry.
The stock had a rough 1995 and an up-and-down 1996. In late July, Newbridge sank sharply after analyst warned the first quarter would not be up to scratch.
But the company proved the prediction false, beating analysts' consensus estimates for its quarter of US$0.49 soundly with a US$0.51 per share profit.
This is the second stock split in Newbridge's history. The first was in June 1993 when it was the hottest property on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Newbridge shares rallied 3.80 to 93.60 in heavy trading on the TSE and were up 3 at 68-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
